storyCards.headline: Rush Rush: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Paula Abdul's "Rush Rush" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Rush Rush" is a song by American singer Paula Abdul, taken from her second studio album, Spellbound (1991).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Rush Rush was released in 1991.
